state:
Goal `tools-server`: `tools:server/the-server-block` has its proofs. Two features of the group
still owe, and `bun nv proofs --owed --group tools:server` lists what each owes:
`tools:server/nvs-service` and `tools:server/nvs-serve`. Nothing is blocked. The two floor checks
the last sweep read red are closed: the `queue.workers` description is inside its length, and the
`Core\Queue` and `Core\Queue\Stats` figures are measured against `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/queue.rs`
as it stands.

The drain section says what the binary does, and the binary differs from
`rule:concurrency/a-drain-closes-a-connection-cleanly` in two places, each a gap record: a reload
begins no drain (`data/gaps/nvs-cli/a-reload-closes-no-connection.json`), and `drain_timeout` bounds
only the wait between two requests, never a request that is running
(`data/gaps/nvs-server/drain-period-does-not-end-a-running-request.json`). A description written
for `nvs service stop` says the same, not what the rule says.

A section passes `help` when it shows a fenced block or a table row holding code; an indented usage
block does not count (`tools/nv/proofs/roster.ts:160`). A fenced `nvs` block in this chapter is
written `nvs skip`. A `.nvst` case cannot name a mount (`crates/nvs-test/src/request.rs:67`), and a
feature of this chapter is credited by a `// covers:` marker above a Rust `#[test]` alone; one
marker names several features, separated by commas. An example or an attack that needs a
configuration key reads the `nvs.toml` in its own directory.

`crates/nvs-cli/tests/live_config.rs`'s `Server` ends its process with `kill`, so a case there
cannot observe a graceful stop, and what a stop does is pinned inside the crates
(`crates/nvs-cli/src/serve.rs:4031`). A figure in `docs/perf/members.ndjson` goes stale when its
implementing file changes, and `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group '<class>'` measures it again.

backlog: A reload closes no connection, against `rule:concurrency/a-drain-closes-a-connection-cleanly` and ADR 0083 § 7 — gap record `data/gaps/nvs-cli/a-reload-closes-no-connection.json`.

The drain period does not end a running HTTP request, against the same rule — gap record `data/gaps/nvs-server/drain-period-does-not-end-a-running-request.json`; `crates/nvs-config/src/server.rs:25`, `crates/nvs-config/src/server.rs:128` and the `drain_timeout` comment in `crates/nvs-config/src/default.toml:471` describe the rule's reading.
`docs/examples/config/queue-workers/01-how-much-of-the-queue-this-instance-works.nvs` misses three bounds of `bun nv proofs --comments` — goal `plain-comments`.
